quotes.how: parsed with the same routine scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs uses, extracted into this file and run over the resolved intent, so every criterionText is the intent's own text: the 3 criteria it declares are ["SC1","SC2","SC3"] and scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs compares them character for character
quotes.edges: read from .project/intent/INTENT.md's own five-column edge-coverage table (Edge | Criterion | Category | Disposition | Detail) for the edge-to-criterion rows, and the test-to-edge mapping from .project/plan/PLAN.md's ## Held-out checks table (Edge | Task | Test), so a row cites the suite the milestone's own plan assigns its edges rather than one this file chose: 4 edge row(s) over the criteria ["SC1","SC2","SC3"] and the suites ["scripts/what-changed.test.mjs"]

why: No row is required, and the list therefore names no driver, no instance and no verdict path: scripts/overlay-verdict-claims.test.mjs refuses a list with no required row that names a driver, so naming one would be the opposite defect.

The reason is not convenience. A required row must name the driver a control-ai-browsers run expression takes to the wave gate, and that driver must return the gate's four readings - toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext - with the required rows together citing drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext. Every fact the 3 criteria this milestone declares is written about is a reading of this repository's own gate: 4 edge row(s) held by ["scripts/what-changed.test.mjs"], against 12 stage(s) of the check chain. None of them is an element's rect or a dev context, so naming a driver would make the gate return a page reading for a claim about the gate.

The portal is not lost by that ruling: each reason names the clause that would have made a row required, and each row cites the suite the milestone itself assigned its criterion, the reading that suite carries and the commands that prove it.

capture.reading: an armed run re-derives the list from the intent this checkout binds, the five-column edge coverage that intent declares and the suites the plan assigns each criterion, and writes it only when a value moved; a default run reads the file and asserts it is exactly what this head derives.

claims.criterionText: Two recorded page snapshots are compared field by field, and the surface names each field that changed with its before and after.
claims.reason: The charter's portal clause makes a verdict required where an insurance-portal route can produce a criterion's facts. SC1 is "Two recorded page snapshots are compared field by field, and the surface names each field that changed with its before and after." - a fact about this repository's own gate, its recordings and the tests that hold them, which no route of any page produces. The gate's one `control-ai-browsers run` driver returns an element's toolElements, drawnRect, descriptor and noDevContext readings, and none of the four can say what a stage examines, what a range is derived from or what a mutant reddens, so a portal-backed row would name a driver that cannot carry the answer. The portal is named because the clause is answered rather than dodged: the evidence is the edge row(s) ["E1","E4"] the intent itself assigns the criterion, held by ["scripts/what-changed.test.mjs","scripts/what-changed.test.mjs"] and recorded as ["criterion SC1","held-out"].
claims.artefact: scripts/what-changed.test.mjs (edge ["E1","E4"] of the intent's own coverage: E1 boundary criterion SC1: A field present in one snapshot and absent from the other is reported as added or removed, never as a change of value.; E4 boundary held-out: A snapshot pair identical except in one field renders exactly one finding, and the same suite asserts the identical-pair case, so "one change" cannot collapse into "no comparison".; the suite carries 21 test declaration(s) in 0 group(s)) -> package.json:7 ("check": 12 stage(s), ["npm run gate:verification","npm run gate:archive-paths","npm run gate:fix-record","npm run format:check"] last, with "npm run gate:archive-paths" and "npm run gate:fix-record" among them)
